name: Hi, I'm Berzish!
bio_p1:
Welcome to my cozy corner of the internet! 🧶

The Yarn Hug started from a small basket of yarn and a big dream to share comfort through handmade creations. Every plushie and cardigan here is stitched by my own two hands with patience, love, and a lot of coffee.
bio_p2: I believe that handmade gifts carry a special kind of magic, creating a warm "hug" that lasts forever. I can't wait to make something special just for you!
